from manim import *
import math

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # Set background color
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        
        # Title setup
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content
        # Using VGroup and arranging to the left
        lecture_texts = [Text(f"• {line}", font_size=20, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT, buff=0.4)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.5).shift(DOWN * 0.5)
        self.add(self.lecture)
        
        # Create a workspace area on the right half of the screen
        self.workspace = RightSideRect = Rectangle(
            width=6, height=6, stroke_width=0
        ).to_edge(RIGHT, buff=0.5)

class Section3Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        # Define the lecture content
        lines = [
            "Unit sphere volume behaves strangely as n increases.",
            "It peaks at five dimensions and then drops.",
            "For very high dimensions, the volume approaches zero.",
            "Compare this to a unit cube's constant volume.",
            "High-dimensional spheres are surprisingly 'empty'."
        ]
        
        self.setup_layout("The Volume Paradox", lines)

        # Helper function for volume of unit n-sphere
        def n_sphere_volume(n):
            return (math.pi ** (n / 2)) / math.gamma(n / 2 + 1)

        # 1. Show the Volume Formula and a visual representation
        self.lecture[0].set_color(YELLOW)
        
        # Simple 3D-ish sphere representation
        sphere_circ = Circle(radius=1.0, color=WHITE, stroke_width=2)
        ellipse_h = Ellipse(width=2.0, height=0.5, color=GREY, stroke_width=1)
        sphere_viz = VGroup(sphere_circ, ellipse_h).move_to(self.workspace.get_top()).shift(DOWN * 1.2)
        
        # Formula with RAW STRING to avoid escape character errors
        vol_formula = MathTex(
            r"V_n(R) = \frac{\pi^{n/2}}{\Gamma(\frac{n}{2} + 1)} R^n", 
            font_size=30, color=WHITE
        ).next_to(sphere_viz, DOWN, buff=0.4)

        self.play(FadeIn(sphere_viz), Write(vol_formula))
        self.wait(1)

        # 2. Peak at n=5
        self.lecture[1].set_color(YELLOW)
        
        # Data for first 5 dimensions
        n_vals_low = list(range(1, 6))
        v_vals_low = [n_sphere_volume(n) for n in n_vals_low]
        
        chart_low = BarChart(
            values=v_vals_low,
            bar_names=[str(n) for n in n_vals_low],
            y_range=[0, 6, 2],
            x_label="n",
            y_label="Vol",
            bar_colors=[YELLOW] * 5,
            axis_config={"color": GREEN, "include_tip": False},
            x_axis_config={"font_size": 18},
            y_axis_config={"font_size": 18},
            height=3.5,
            width=5
        ).move_to(self.workspace.get_center()).shift(DOWN * 0.5)

        self.play(Create(chart_low))
        self.wait(1)

        # 3. High dimensions approach zero
        self.lecture[2].set_color(RED)
        
        n_vals_high = list(range(1, 21))
        v_vals_high = [n_sphere_volume(n) for n in n_vals_high]
        # Colors: Yellow for first 5, Red for others
        colors_high = [YELLOW] * 5 + [RED] * 15
        
        chart_high = BarChart(
            values=v_vals_high,
            bar_names=[str(n) if n % 5 == 0 or n == 1 else "" for n in n_vals_high],
            y_range=[0, 6, 2],
            x_label="n",
            y_label="Vol",
            bar_colors=colors_high,
            axis_config={"color": GREEN, "include_tip": False},
            x_axis_config={"font_size": 16},
            y_axis_config={"font_size": 16},
            height=3.5,
            width=5
        ).move_to(chart_low.get_center())

        self.play(ReplacementTransform(chart_low, chart_high))
        self.wait(1)

        # 4. Compare with Unit Cube
        self.lecture[3].set_color(YELLOW)
        
        # Horizontal line at Volume = 1 for the cube
        line_y_val = chart_high.coords_to_point(0, 1)[1]
        line_start = [chart_high.c2p(0,0)[0], line_y_val, 0]
        line_end = [chart_high.c2p(20,0)[0], line_y_val, 0]
        
        cube_line = Line(line_start, line_end, color=BLUE, stroke_width=3)
        cube_label = Text("Cube Vol = 1", font_size=16, color=BLUE).next_to(cube_line, UP, buff=0.1)
        
        self.play(Create(cube_line), Write(cube_label))
        self.wait(1)

        # 5. Highlight n=20 emptiness
        self.lecture[4].set_color(RED)
        
        # Using index 19 for n=20
        bar_20 = chart_high.bars[19]
        highlight_box = SurroundingRectangle(bar_20, color=WHITE, buff=0.05)
        
        v20_val = n_sphere_volume(20)
        # Using raw string and manual formatting to avoid f-string curly brace confusion
        label_20 = MathTex(
            r"V_{20} \approx " + f"{v20_val:.4f}", 
            font_size=20, color=WHITE
        ).next_to(highlight_box, UP, buff=0.2)

        self.play(Create(highlight_box), Write(label_20))
        self.wait(3)
